name: rotmg-loot-roadmap
description: RotMG loot roadmap - one source, two products: the standalone roadmap.html and a Tauri 2 desktop overlay.

scripts.verify:standalone: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const h=fs.readFileSync('roadmap.html','utf8'); const left=['__ROTMG_DATA__','__SPRITE_ATLAS__','__BESTIARY__'].filter(t=>h.includes(t)); if(left.length) throw new Error('unsubstituted placeholder: '+left.join(', ')); for(const [what,needle] of [['sprite atlas','data:image/png;base64,'],['bestiary','data:image/jpeg;base64,'],['item data','id=\"rotmg-data\"'],['app code','function render()']]) if(!h.includes(needle)) throw new Error(what+' missing from roadmap.html'); if(h.length < 5e6) throw new Error('roadmap.html is only '+h.length+' bytes - a payload did not inline'); console.log('  standalone ok: '+(h.length/1048576).toFixed(2)+' MB');"
scripts.build: npm run build:standalone && npm run verify:standalone && npm run build:app
